perpignanpalaisrois.name: Palace of the Kings of Majorca
perpignanpalaisrois.slogan: A Gothic court on a Catalan hill, with Vauban's walls around it.
perpignanpalaisrois.line: In 1415 Emperor Sigismund held a summit here to make Antipope Benedict XIII resign; Benedict refused.

perpignancastillet.name: Castillet
perpignancastillet.slogan: Red brick gate that still guards Perpignan's old town.
perpignancastillet.line: Its Catalan name means 'little castle'; building ran from 1368 to 1542, to designs by Guillem Guitard.

colliourebelltower.name: Notre-Dame-des-Anges, Collioure
colliourebelltower.slogan: A pink bell tower that Matisse and Derain could not stop painting.
colliourebelltower.line: In the summer of 1905 Matisse and Derain painted this harbour in such bold colours that critics named them the Fauves.

canigouabbey.name: Saint-Martin-du-Canigou Abbey
canigouabbey.slogan: Benedictine stone clinging to the flank of the Canigó.
canigouabbey.line: Founded by Count Guifred II between 1005 and 1009, who later became a monk here and died in 1050.

queribuscucugnan.name: Quéribus Castle
queribuscucugnan.slogan: An eagle's nest at 728 metres, the last Cathar holdout.
queribuscucugnan.line: Its defender Chabert de Barbaira surrendered in 1255 without a fight, for reasons still unclear.
